description: ERC-8262 provider protocol vectors (SPEC.md section 10). Fixtures only: no Oracle is deployed, every address, root and signer hash is illustrative, and wallets are PUBLIC Hardhat/Anvil TEST addresses. `discovery` and `evidence` documents all validate against their schemas; `schemaCases` all fail; `evaluationCases` and `quorumCases` reproduce the section 10.5 and 10.6 algorithms. An evaluation names its documents as fixtures, or as `{ schemaCase }`: a 200 whose body fails its schema. `context.allowlist` is the consumer's pin of each trust domain to its attestor; `context.registry` stands in for the consumer's Oracle reads; `context.seenDiscovery` / `context.seenEvidence` name documents in the consumer's observation store and `context.seenRevoked` the (trustDomainId, evidenceId) pairs it recorded as revoked from a 410 or from a revoked body (section 10.5 evidence_revoked, recorded even during a discovery outage); `context.announcedEvidenceId` is the id the consumer was given and requests; `context.discoveryFetch` / `context.evidenceFetch` give the host each document came from and the HTTP status (a non-200 evidence fetch evaluates no document); `context.proof` holds the public inputs of the Oracle-verified proof the evidence feeds. A quorum case's `context` is shared by its members, each of which adds its own fetches, announced id and proof. `limits` carries the protocol constants; `refusals` lists the refusals in check order.

schemaCases.name: discovery-native-two-sources
schemaCases.description: A native trust domain is one source.

schemaCases.name: discovery-single-label-trust-domain
schemaCases.description: trustDomainId is a DNS host with at least two labels.

schemaCases.name: discovery-attestor-zero
schemaCases.description: The Oracle rejects providerId 0.

schemaCases.name: discovery-attestor-not-decimal-string
schemaCases.description: attestorProviderId is a uint256 decimal string, never a JSON number.

schemaCases.name: discovery-key-without-material
schemaCases.description: A credential-root key names its credentialSigner.

schemaCases.name: discovery-carries-points
schemaCases.description: Scoring is the consumer's: no points, category or tier fields.

schemaCases.name: evidence-revoked-without-revoked-at
schemaCases.description: Revoked evidence states when.

schemaCases.name: evidence-active-with-revoked-at
schemaCases.description: revokedAt is present iff revoked.

schemaCases.name: evidence-checksummed-subject
schemaCases.description: Addresses are lowercase hex.

schemaCases.name: evidence-carries-points
schemaCases.description: Scoring is the consumer's: no points, category or tier fields.

schemaCases.name: evidence-credential-without-root
schemaCases.description: A proof type 4 artifact names its credential root.

schemaCases.name: evidence-claim-type-without-namespace
schemaCases.description: claimType is `<namespace>.<name>`.

schemaCases.name: evidence-guessable-id
schemaCases.description: evidenceId carries at least 128 bits (22 base64url characters).

schemaCases.name: evidence-unknown-protocol-version
schemaCases.description: A consumer refuses a version it does not implement.

schemaCases.name: discovery-too-many-keys
schemaCases.description: At most 32 keys (likewise deployments, sources and claims per source).

schemaCases.name: discovery-unknown-protocol-version
schemaCases.description: A consumer refuses a version it does not implement.

schemaCases.name: discovery-ipv4-trust-domain
schemaCases.description: trustDomainId is never an IP literal (here the cloud metadata address).

schemaCases.name: discovery-numeric-last-label-trust-domain
schemaCases.description: A host whose last label is numeric is parsed as IPv4 by WHATWG URL (`0x7f.1` is 127.0.0.1): the last label starts with a letter.

schemaCases.name: discovery-updated-at-milliseconds
schemaCases.description: Timestamps are Unix seconds, at most 4294967295: a millisecond updatedAt fails the schema instead of locking the trust domain out.

schemaCases.name: discovery-attestor-above-uint256
schemaCases.description: attestorProviderId is at most 2^256 - 1.

schemaCases.name: discovery-revocation-check-too-short
schemaCases.description: revocationCheckSeconds is at least 60.

schemaCases.name: evidence-issued-at-beyond-uint32
schemaCases.description: Timestamps are at most 4294967295.

schemaCases.name: evidence-id-path-characters
schemaCases.description: evidenceId is base64url only: no `.`, `/` or `%` that a URL parser would rewrite.

evaluationCases.name: native-accepted
evaluationCases.description: Native trust domain, Base Sepolia, current key, root registered to attestor 7.

evaluationCases.name: gateway-accepted-base
evaluationCases.description: Gateway trust domain on Base: differs from native-accepted in source, trust domain, attestor, policy, expiry, chain and Oracle.

evaluationCases.name: gateway-human-tech-accepted
evaluationCases.description: One source behind the gateway.

evaluationCases.name: gateway-sumsub-accepted
evaluationCases.description: Another source behind the gateway: same trust domain and attestor. Its lifetime is exactly the 365-day maximum.

evaluationCases.name: gateway-signed-signals-accepted
evaluationCases.description: Proof type 7 claim; the current signed-signals key's hash is registered to attestor 1.

evaluationCases.name: alias-accepted-individually
evaluationCases.description: The consumer allowlists a second host of the gateway operator under the same attestor.

evaluationCases.name: rotation-retired-key-within-window
evaluationCases.description: Rotation, proof type 4: evidence issued by the retired credential-root key before its notAfter is not refused for the retirement; the Oracle still holds its root valid.

evaluationCases.name: replay-identical-redelivery
evaluationCases.description: Replay: the same evidenceId with identical fields is idempotent.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-id-scoped-by-trust-domain
evaluationCases.description: A revoked document from another trust domain that reuses this evidenceId does not affect it: observations are keyed by (trustDomainId, evidenceId).

evaluationCases.name: discovery-newer-than-observed
evaluationCases.description: A document newer than the one observed earlier replaces it.

evaluationCases.name: issued-within-clock-skew
evaluationCases.description: issuedAt 60 seconds ahead of the consumer's clock is tolerated.

evaluationCases.name: impostor-host-not-allowed
evaluationCases.description: A host outside the consumer's allowlist copying the gateway's attestor, root key and root: its documents alone would pass every later check.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-not-from-discovery-host
evaluationCases.description: Evidence obtained anywhere but the trust domain's own host (a push body, a relay, another provider) is unauthenticated.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-unavailable
evaluationCases.description: The discovery fetch failed (here 503). A consumer never substitutes a cached copy for a fetch.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-gone
evaluationCases.description: 410 Gone for a held evidenceId is final: the consumer records (trustDomainId, evidenceId) as revoked.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-not-found-is-unavailable
evaluationCases.description: 404 is unavailable, not revoked: refused for now and never recorded, so a provider misdeploy is recoverable.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-redirect-is-unavailable
evaluationCases.description: A consumer never follows redirects: a 3xx is unavailable.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-names-other-trust-domain
evaluationCases.description: An allowlisted host serving a document that names another trust domain.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-from-other-trust-domain
evaluationCases.description: Native evidence presented under the gateway's discovery document.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-duplicate-deployment
evaluationCases.description: Two attestors for one deployment in one document: one trust domain would count twice in a quorum.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-duplicate-key
evaluationCases.description: A keyId listed twice (here once revoked): first-match and last-match consumers would disagree.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-duplicate-source
evaluationCases.description: A sourceId listed twice.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-rolled-back
evaluationCases.description: A document older than one the consumer observed (a stale cache or rollback).

evaluationCases.name: replay-across-chains
evaluationCases.description: Base evidence presented to a Base Sepolia consumer.

evaluationCases.name: replay-across-oracles
evaluationCases.description: Right chain, different Oracle deployment.

evaluationCases.name: attestor-not-declared
evaluationCases.description: Native evidence claiming attestor 1 while the consumer pins the native trust domain to attestor 7.

evaluationCases.name: impostor-pinned-to-other-attestor
evaluationCases.description: The consumer onboarded the host as attestor 9; its documents claim attestor 1. The pin, not the document, decides.

evaluationCases.name: claim-type-not-declared
evaluationCases.description: human-tech declares personhood.unique only.

evaluationCases.name: policy-not-declared
evaluationCases.description: A policyId the source does not declare.

evaluationCases.name: key-not-declared
evaluationCases.description: keyId absent from discovery.

evaluationCases.name: key-use-mismatch
evaluationCases.description: A proof type 4 artifact naming a signed-signals key.

evaluationCases.name: rotation-revoked-key
evaluationCases.description: Key revocation is retroactive: issuedAt inside the key's window does not help.

evaluationCases.name: key-revocation-not-reversible
evaluationCases.description: A newer document that drops a key's revokedAt does not restore the key: the consumer remembers revocations per trust domain.

evaluationCases.name: rotation-retired-key-after-window
evaluationCases.description: Rotation: the retired key cannot issue after its notAfter.

evaluationCases.name: rotation-retired-signals-key
evaluationCases.description: Rotation, proof types 7-9: a retired signed-signals key ends at notAfter, even for evidence issued inside its window and even while the Oracle still holds its hash.

evaluationCases.name: credential-signer-not-on-oracle
evaluationCases.description: The current credential-root key's credentialSigner is not the Oracle's getCredentialSigner for the attestor.

evaluationCases.name: revocation-root-revoked-on-oracle
evaluationCases.description: Revocation on-chain: the root is no longer valid for attestor 1.

evaluationCases.name: revocation-signer-hash-revoked-on-oracle
evaluationCases.description: Revocation on-chain: the signed-signals hash was revoked from the registry.

evaluationCases.name: replay-across-wallets
evaluationCases.description: Evidence for one wallet presented for another.

evaluationCases.name: replay-evidence-id-reused
evaluationCases.description: Same evidenceId, different immutable field (an in-place extension).

evaluationCases.name: revocation-status-revoked
evaluationCases.description: The provider reports the evidence revoked.

evaluationCases.name: revocation-not-reversible
evaluationCases.description: An active response after the consumer observed revoked.

evaluationCases.name: validity-window-empty
evaluationCases.description: expiresAt equal to issuedAt.

evaluationCases.name: validity-too-long
evaluationCases.description: expiresAt one second past the 365-day maximum lifetime.

evaluationCases.name: issued-in-future
evaluationCases.description: issuedAt 61 seconds ahead of the consumer's clock.

evaluationCases.name: expired
evaluationCases.description: expiresAt is exclusive: now == expiresAt is expired.

evaluationCases.name: proof-multi-signed-slots-include-key
evaluationCases.description: A proof type 9 proof whose active signer slots include the evidence key's hash, next to another provider's slot, matches.

evaluationCases.name: proof-attestor-mismatch
evaluationCases.description: A verified proof type 4 proof for the same wallet whose provider_id is another attestor (the gateway's): it does not feed this evidence.

evaluationCases.name: proof-provider-mismatch-same-root
evaluationCases.description: provider_id differs while credential_root is the evidence's: only the provider_id input is wrong.

evaluationCases.name: proof-root-mismatch
evaluationCases.description: provider_id matches, but credential_root is another root the attestor holds valid.

evaluationCases.name: proof-credential-type-mismatch
evaluationCases.description: The proof attests another credential type than the evidence names.

evaluationCases.name: proof-submitter-mismatch
evaluationCases.description: The proof was submitted by another wallet than the evidence's subject.

evaluationCases.name: proof-type-mismatch
evaluationCases.description: The evidence feeds proof type 4; the verified proof is a type 9 proof signed by the same trust domain's signed-signals key.

evaluationCases.name: proof-signer-hash-mismatch
evaluationCases.description: A proof type 7 proof signed by another attestor's registered key does not feed evidence naming the gateway's key.

evaluationCases.name: proof-multi-signed-slots-omit-key
evaluationCases.description: A proof type 9 proof whose active signer slots do not include the evidence key.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-id-dot-segments
evaluationCases.description: An announced evidenceId with dot segments would leave /v1/erc8262/evidence/ once a URL parser normalizes it; it fails the evidenceId rule and is never fetched.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-id-percent-encoded
evaluationCases.description: Percent-encoded dot segments are refused the same way: `%` is outside the rule.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-id-too-short
evaluationCases.description: An announced evidenceId shorter than 22 characters carries under 128 bits.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-id-body-mismatch
evaluationCases.description: The host answers the request for one evidenceId with another valid document of its own.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-id-case-differs
evaluationCases.description: evidenceIds compare exactly: a body whose id differs only in case is another id.

evaluationCases.name: key-material-relisted-under-new-id
evaluationCases.description: After gw-root-0 was revoked, a newer document drops it and lists its credentialSigner as gw-root-2 (and the attestor re-points the Oracle to it): revocation is remembered by key material, not only keyId.

evaluationCases.name: revocation-attestor-denied-on-oracle
evaluationCases.description: The Oracle guardian denied attestor 7 (isProviderDenied): its evidence is refused although its root is still registered and the Oracle's ATTESTATION path does not check denial itself.

evaluationCases.name: revocation-attestor-denied-signed
evaluationCases.description: A denied attestor's proof type 7 evidence is refused although its signer hash is still registered.

evaluationCases.name: revocation-gone-not-reversible
evaluationCases.description: A 410 recorded earlier for this (trustDomainId, evidenceId) is final: a later 200 with status active is refused.

evaluationCases.name: gone-scoped-by-trust-domain
evaluationCases.description: A 410 recorded for the same evidenceId under another trust domain does not affect it.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-body-fails-schema
evaluationCases.description: A 200 whose discovery body fails its schema (here a points field) is unavailable: refused for now, never recorded.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-unsupported-protocol-version
evaluationCases.description: A discovery document of a protocolVersion the consumer does not implement.

evaluationCases.name: evidence-unsupported-protocol-version
evaluationCases.description: An evidence body of a protocolVersion the consumer does not implement is unavailable, never revoked.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-updated-at-within-skew
evaluationCases.description: A discovery updatedAt 60 seconds ahead of the consumer's clock is tolerated.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-updated-at-in-future
evaluationCases.description: A discovery updatedAt 61 seconds ahead (one past the skew) is refused and not recorded, so it cannot make every later document stale.

evaluationCases.name: root-registered-to-other-attestor
evaluationCases.description: The Oracle holds the root valid, but registered to attestor 7, not the gateway's attestor 1.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-attestor-differs-from-pin
evaluationCases.description: The evidence names the pinned attestor 7, but the discovery document names 9 for the deployment.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-lacks-deployment
evaluationCases.description: The discovery document does not list the evidence's deployment.

evaluationCases.name: discovery-same-updated-at
evaluationCases.description: Re-fetching the document already recorded (equal updatedAt) is not stale.

evaluationCases.name: issued-at-key-not-before
evaluationCases.description: issuedAt equal to the key's notBefore is inside its window.

evaluationCases.name: issued-before-key-not-before
evaluationCases.description: issuedAt one second before the key's notBefore.

evaluationCases.name: issued-last-second-before-key-not-after
evaluationCases.description: issuedAt one second before the retired key's notAfter is inside its window.

evaluationCases.name: issued-at-key-not-after
evaluationCases.description: notAfter is exclusive: issuedAt equal to it is outside the window.

evaluationCases.name: signals-key-retired-at-not-after
evaluationCases.description: A signed-signals key is retired from the instant the consumer's clock equals notAfter.

evaluationCases.name: signals-key-last-second-before-not-after
evaluationCases.description: One second before notAfter the signed-signals key still serves.

evaluationCases.name: deployment-mismatch-chain-only
evaluationCases.description: The consumer's Oracle address, another chain.

evaluationCases.name: proof-type-not-declared
evaluationCases.description: human-tech declares personhood.unique for proof type 4 only, not 7.

evaluationCases.name: credential-signer-checked-before-announced-not-after
evaluationCases.description: nk-root-2026b carries a future notAfter: one second before it the key is still current, so its credentialSigner must be the Oracle's (here the Oracle holds another).

evaluationCases.name: credential-signer-not-checked-from-not-after
evaluationCases.description: From notAfter on the key is retired and the Oracle holds its successor: credentialSigner is no longer compared.

evaluationCases.name: order-not-allowed-before-evidence-id
evaluationCases.description: Host outside the allowlist (trust_domain_not_allowed) and an invalid announced evidenceId (evidence_id_invalid).

evaluationCases.name: order-evidence-id-before-origin
evaluationCases.description: Invalid announced evidenceId (evidence_id_invalid) and evidence from another host (origin_mismatch).

evaluationCases.name: order-origin-before-gone
evaluationCases.description: A 410 relayed from another host (origin_mismatch before evidence_gone): only the discovery host's own 410 is recorded.

evaluationCases.name: order-gone-before-discovery-unavailable
evaluationCases.description: A 410 from the allowlisted host while its discovery fetch fails (evidence_gone before discovery_unavailable): the revocation is final and recorded even during a discovery outage.

evaluationCases.name: order-gone-before-discovery-invalid-body
evaluationCases.description: A 410 from the allowlisted host while its discovery body fails the schema (evidence_gone before discovery_unavailable).

evaluationCases.name: gone-during-outage-stays-revoked
evaluationCases.description: After a 410 (order-gone-before-discovery-unavailable) or a revoked body (revoked-body-during-discovery-outage) was recorded during a discovery outage, discovery is back and the host answers 200 active: refused (evidence_revoked).

evaluationCases.name: revoked-body-during-discovery-outage
evaluationCases.description: A schema-valid revoked body for the announced id from the allowlisted host while its discovery fetch fails: refused and recorded as revoked under (host, evidenceId). Only status and evidenceId are read.

evaluationCases.name: revoked-body-with-invalid-discovery
evaluationCases.description: A revoked body while the host's discovery body fails its schema: refused and recorded as revoked.

evaluationCases.name: revoked-body-id-mismatch-during-outage
evaluationCases.description: A revoked body for another evidenceId than the announced one during a discovery outage is not recorded; the outage is the refusal.

evaluationCases.name: revoked-body-id-mismatch
evaluationCases.description: The same id-mismatched revoked body with discovery available: not recorded.

evaluationCases.name: revoked-body-fails-schema-during-outage
evaluationCases.description: A revoked body that fails the evidence schema (no revokedAt) during a discovery outage is not recorded; the outage is the refusal.

evaluationCases.name: revoked-body-fails-schema
evaluationCases.description: The same schema-invalid revoked body with discovery available: unavailable, not recorded.

evaluationCases.name: revoked-body-from-relay
evaluationCases.description: A revoked body fetched from another host than discovery's (a relay): origin_mismatch, not recorded.

evaluationCases.name: order-gone-before-revoked
evaluationCases.description: A 410 (evidence_gone) for an id already recorded as revoked (evidence_revoked).

evaluationCases.name: order-discovery-unavailable-before-evidence-unavailable
evaluationCases.description: Both fetches fail, discovery with 503 and evidence with 404 (discovery_unavailable before evidence_unavailable).

evaluationCases.name: order-evidence-unavailable-before-trust-domain
evaluationCases.description: A 404 for the evidence (evidence_unavailable) and a discovery document naming another trust domain (trust_domain_mismatch).

evaluationCases.name: order-trust-domain-before-evidence-id-mismatch
evaluationCases.description: Evidence of another trust domain (trust_domain_mismatch) whose id is not the one requested (evidence_id_mismatch).

evaluationCases.name: order-evidence-id-mismatch-before-discovery-invalid
evaluationCases.description: A body for another evidenceId (evidence_id_mismatch) under a document repeating a keyId (discovery_invalid).

evaluationCases.name: order-discovery-invalid-before-future
evaluationCases.description: A document repeating a keyId (discovery_invalid) whose updatedAt is more than the skew ahead of the clock (discovery_from_future).

evaluationCases.name: order-future-before-stale
evaluationCases.description: A document ahead of the clock (discovery_from_future) that is also older than one recorded (discovery_stale).

evaluationCases.name: order-stale-before-deployment
evaluationCases.description: A stale document (discovery_stale) and evidence for another deployment (deployment_mismatch).

evaluationCases.name: order-deployment-before-attestor
evaluationCases.description: Another Oracle (deployment_mismatch) and an attestor other than the pin (attestor_mismatch).

evaluationCases.name: order-attestor-before-claim
evaluationCases.description: The consumer pins the gateway to attestor 9 (attestor_mismatch) and the claim is undeclared (claim_not_declared).

evaluationCases.name: order-claim-before-key
evaluationCases.description: An undeclared policyId (claim_not_declared) and an undeclared keyId (key_not_declared).

evaluationCases.name: order-key-use-before-revoked
evaluationCases.description: A proof type 7 claim naming a credential-root key (key_use_mismatch) that is revoked (key_revoked).

evaluationCases.name: order-revoked-before-window
evaluationCases.description: A revoked key (key_revoked) named by evidence issued after its notAfter (key_not_valid_at_issuance).

evaluationCases.name: order-window-before-retired
evaluationCases.description: A signed-signals key named by evidence issued after its notAfter (key_not_valid_at_issuance), and retired at evaluation (key_retired).

evaluationCases.name: order-retired-before-denied
evaluationCases.description: A retired signed-signals key (key_retired) of an attestor the Oracle has denied (attestor_denied).

evaluationCases.name: order-denied-before-credential-signer
evaluationCases.description: A denied attestor (attestor_denied) whose Oracle credential signer also differs from the current key's (credential_signer_mismatch).

evaluationCases.name: order-credential-signer-before-registry
evaluationCases.description: The Oracle holds another credential signer (credential_signer_mismatch) and no longer holds the root (not_registered_on_oracle).

evaluationCases.name: order-registry-before-subject
evaluationCases.description: A root no longer on the Oracle (not_registered_on_oracle) presented for another wallet (subject_mismatch).

evaluationCases.name: order-subject-before-conflict
evaluationCases.description: Another wallet (subject_mismatch) and an evidenceId reused with a changed field (evidence_id_conflict).

evaluationCases.name: recorded-revocation-before-conflict
evaluationCases.description: An evidenceId reused with a changed field against a recorded revoked document: the recorded revocation (evidence_revoked) is checked before discovery, so before evidence_id_conflict.

evaluationCases.name: recorded-revocation-before-window-empty
evaluationCases.description: A recorded 410 (evidence_revoked) for evidence with an empty validity window (invalid_validity_window).

evaluationCases.name: order-conflict-before-window-empty
evaluationCases.description: An evidenceId re-served with changed times (evidence_id_conflict) that are also an empty window (invalid_validity_window).

evaluationCases.name: order-too-long-before-not-yet-valid
evaluationCases.description: A lifetime past 365 days (validity_too_long) starting in the future (not_yet_valid).

evaluationCases.name: order-expired-before-proof
evaluationCases.description: Expired evidence (expired) fed to a proof of another attestor (proof_mismatch).

quorumCases.name: gateway-two-sources-one-trust-domain
quorumCases.description: Two KYC sources (persona, sumsub) re-signed by one gateway: one trust domain, one attestor, so 2-of-N is NOT met.

quorumCases.name: native-and-gateway-two-trust-domains
quorumCases.description: One native and one gateway trust domain: two attestors, quorum met.

quorumCases.name: three-sources-two-trust-domains
quorumCases.description: Three KYC sources across two trust domains count two.

quorumCases.name: alias-host-shares-attestor
quorumCases.description: Two allowlisted hosts pinned to one Oracle providerId are one trust domain on-chain and count once.

quorumCases.name: refused-member-not-counted
quorumCases.description: Only evidence that passes the section 10.5 evaluation counts.

quorumCases.name: impostor-not-counted
quorumCases.description: A host outside the allowlist claiming the gateway's attestor adds nothing.

quorumCases.name: claim-types-not-pooled
quorumCases.description: A personhood claim does not count toward a KYC requirement.

quorumCases.name: multi-signed-two-trust-domains
quorumCases.description: Proof type 9 KYC from the native and the gateway trust domains: two attestors, quorum met.

quorumCases.name: proof-types-not-pooled
quorumCases.description: A proof type 4 credential does not count toward a proof type 9 requirement.

quorumCases.name: attestors-sorted-numerically
quorumCases.description: attestors lists providerIds in ascending numeric order: 7 before 12, though `12` sorts first as a string.

quorumCases.name: observed-revocation-not-counted
quorumCases.description: Members are evaluated against the consumer's observation store: a 410 it recorded for the gateway evidence removes that member.

quorumCases.name: proof-mismatched-member-not-counted
quorumCases.description: The native trust domain's verified proof presented for the gateway evidence does not feed it, so one proof never counts as two attestors.
